section.7: The Book of the Adhan (The Call to Prayer)

7.name_native: The Book of the Adhan (The Call to Prayer)

hadiths.text: It was narrated from Salim, from his father, that the Prophet (S.A.W) said:"Bilal calls the Adhan during the night, so eat and drink until you hear Ibn Umm Maktoom calling the Adhan
